Not checked whether `Core\Secret`'s card drops `secret` the same way. Owner: the card renderer behind `rule:core-api/reference-card`.

`Core\Arr::contains($allowed, $sort)` does not compile for a `tainted string` needle against an `array<string>` (E0401), so the allowlist check `rule:security/launderers-are-sink-named` expects before `assertTrusted` must be written with `==`. A design question for the `tainted` axis, not this goal's to decide.
